description.value: A family-owned guest house on Salt Spring Island run by the Brown family since 2003, offering six main guest house rooms plus cottage and studio suites set amidst gardens with cascading wisteria. Located a 10-minute walk from Ganges Village, it is well-positioned for cyclists arriving by ferry or exploring the island. The property is all on one level and provides covered, lockable bicycle storage.

address.value: 224 Park Drive, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2R6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's policies page explicitly states 'Covered, lockable bicycle storage is available,' confirming secure bike storage. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by the policies page ('Free WiFi available') and OSM tag internet_access=yes. Breakfast is explicitly negative: 'We do not serve any meals (including breakfast).' The FAQ confirms nearby food ('lots of restaurant options' in Ganges Village, 10-min walk) and nearby grocery ('2 grocery stores within walking distance'). A major concern is that OSM lists the community as 'Chemainus,' but the website and coordinates clearly place this on Salt Spring Island near Ganges.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chemainus' but the business is located on Salt Spring Island (Ganges area); coordinates confirm Salt Spring Island. Community field should be corrected.
Website copyright shows 2022, though content appears current and business appears operational.
OSM lists 9 rooms but website describes 6 main guest house rooms plus separate cottage and studio suites, so the count may differ depending on what is counted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Guest house on Salt Spring Island with confirmed covered lockable bicycle storage, free Wi-Fi, and walkable access to restaurants and groceries — a strong fit for touring cyclists.
